summary: NORSK ETIKETT AS (org. no. 979 566 387) is a private limited company (AS) based in Stavanger, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1998-01-29. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 17.250 (Produksjon av varer av papir og papp ellers); it has 25 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 101.9 m and net income was NOK 4.5 m. CEO: Petter Haaland; board chair: Frode Haaland; auditor: BDO AS.
